pdfUrls.title: PDF URLs
pdfUrls.description: Direct links to PDF files (up to 5,000 per run, max 100 MB each).

ocr.title: OCR for scanned pages
enumTitles: Auto: only pages without a text layer
ocr.description: Scanned pages have no text layer; OCR reads the text from the page image. Auto only runs OCR where needed.

ocrLanguage.title: OCR language
ocrLanguage.description: Language of the scanned text (used only for OCR).

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages of each PDF.

includePages.title: Include per-page text
includePages.description: Also output the text of each page separately (in addition to the full text).
